nodes.v: Drawer · width steps and the drag handle
The 2px edge is the handle — drag to any width, double-click to reset. There is no resize affordance in the sidebar today: LeftSidebar.tsx and .css carry no resize, onMouseDown or drag.

60 rail + 700 drawer + 300 inspector = 1060, so the canvas lane is 380 while the page frame’s floor is 1024 (canvasStyles.ts:57). Expanding a panel to read it pushes the page being edited into heavy horizontal scroll, and the only way back is the same toggle. Say what it costs, or re-fit.
Media sets 560 and Templates 700 from runtime events (LeftSidebar.tsx:580-587), so three widths ship from two controls. One control, one remembered width.
The step in between is filed, not drawn

SPEC-NAVIGATION §5.2 proposes 560; SPEC-PAGES-PANEL and SPEC-PUBLISH-PANEL draw 700, and LeftSidebar.tsx:586-587 does 700. 700 is drawn; 560 stays filed on Shell · open decisions (2844:12186). (UX-F-15)
